verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows image, audio, or file input. The docs consistently frame the input `state` as text: the quickstart says to paste any text as the state, context budgets are given in tokens, and the document cookbooks work on text content. So text-only is implied, but no page explicitly says other modalities are unsupported, and the vendor's own limitations page does not mention modality. missing for 10: explicit statement that input is text-only (or documented multimodal input), modality listed in the models or limitations page, independent confirmation of input scope.
